what_to_detect: A leveler with fewer level counters than its first level symbol's N1 has the power/toughness of its uppermost box and none of its level abilities.
near_miss: A leveler with N1 or more level counters, whose level static sets its base power/toughness.
record_fields: gen-3 card lines (active flag on the level statics)

what_to_detect: A candidate whose target restriction reads power has a leveler card outside the battlefield as a legal target by the power of its uppermost box.
near_miss: Not distinct within the rule: the contrast is a card outside the battlefield whose own power fails the restriction.
